text: Israeli courts have rejected two petitions seeking the release of 14 Palestinian doctors from Gaza who are held in Israeli prisons without charge or trial, according to Physicians for Human Rights Israel.

Lawmakers want Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify behind closed doors next week, after a classified memo warned of his ties to Alice Huang, whom US intelligence believes is a Chinese spy.

Trump says it "didn't make much of an impact on me."
🚨 Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦: Three Houthi cruise missiles fired toward Riyadh were intercepted, the Saudi led coalition says.

Pakistan 🇵🇰: Pakistani Taliban (TTP) militants attacked a Pakistani Army post in Kohat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

Footage shows a militant using what appears to be a US made M16A4 rifle fitted with a Longot TR650L or iRay RICO 2 thermal scope. https://t.co/f36uH2IVfg

Smuggling networks on Pakistan's Balochistan coast, around Gwadar, Jiwani and Pasni, move Iranian diesel and gasoline across the border by small boat, truck, motorbike and even pack animals.

An estimated 6 million liters cross every day.

https://t.co/LmaE34B4xk

US Ambassador to Turkey Tom Barrack on the Strait of Hormuz: "Iraq, Turkey and Syria are the key to this transition, in whatever direction you want to go."

On the strait itself: "Everybody's saying we need an insurance policy."
🚨 Ukrainian drones took out a Russian Ka 52 attack helicopter and an Mi 8 transport helicopter in Leningrad oblast yesterday.

🚨 Follow up: Iran's Mohsen Rezaei now points at Europe. Any distant base used to launch US jets against Iran will be hit, including some US bases in Europe.

He says Iran may also hit islands the US thinks are out of range, as old limits are gone.

🚨 Pakistan 🇵🇰: 11 police personnel are feared dead after an attack in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, a rescue group spokesperson says.

Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian met in Antalya, Turkey.

Iraq 🇮🇶: Kataib Hezbollah says it will hold the Al Zaidi government responsible for any attack on the headquarters of the armed factions.

The warning also covers any strike on Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF) headquarters.

🚨 G7 foreign ministers voice grave concern over Iran's role in violent plots against their citizens and territory, including threats to Britain's RAF Fairford base, the UK says.

They also condemned Iranian and North Korean military aid to Russia.
A Jewish People Policy Institute poll taken days after Israel's October 2026 Knesset elections found that 39% of Arab Israelis would emigrate if given a practical opportunity.

US gas prices just posted their biggest one day drop in 18 years, according to AAA.

The national average fell about 3.6 cents to $3.94 a gallon.

🚨 Zelensky: Ukraine will test the first "European anti ballistic" system this winter.

The plan comes as Kyiv warns its Patriot batteries are running empty while missiles are diverted to the Middle East.

Yemen 🇾🇪: Video shows Saudi backed PLC forces pounding Houthi positions with an automatic grenade launcher.

The weapon is a very rare Chinese Norinco LG5, the 40mm export version of the QLU 11, most likely supplied by Saudi Arabia.

https://t.co/LrJgS3sWYt
Jared Kushner on Europe's role in the Ukraine talks: if Europe could pick one person to speak for it, that would be a bigger win than getting Russia to let Europeans into the negotiations.
Russia's chief negotiator Vladimir Medinsky after the talks: "Every inch of Russian land will be returned to Russia one way or another."

Zelensky sounds the alarm on air defence: "The missiles are going to the Middle East. And what do we have?"

He says Ukraine is left with empty Patriot systems against Russian ballistic missiles it mostly has nothing to shoot down with.

🚨 New details from the Ukraine Russia talks: Kyiv rejected redrawing administrative borders around Donbas to halt the fighting.

Russia rejected every ceasefire proposal and said Europe's team was on holiday. Mediators push for a Christmas truce.
